[[File:Hellhound icon.png|left]]
'''Hellhounds''' are mid- to high-level monsters often given as a [[slayer assignment]] to mid- to high-level players. However, despite being susceptible to [[demon slayer (effect)|demon slayer]], they do not count for the [[demons (Slayer assignment)|demons]] Slayer assignment; they only count for their own specific [[hellhounds (Slayer assignment)|hellhounds]] assignment.

Hellhounds are primarily killed for [[gold charm]]s and [[clue scroll (hard)|hard clue scrolls]], although more emphasis is put on the latter, as hellhounds have the highest drop rate of hard clues of all monsters that drop them.

==Trivia==
* [[Slayer Master]]s describe hellhounds as "a cross between [[Dog (race)|dogs]] and [[demons]]". They are affected by the powers of [[silverlight]] and [[darklight]]. Along with the [[bloodveld]], they are the only demons that drop bones rather than ashes.
** They also don't count when assigned a "dog" slayer task.
* On [[16 June]] [[2009]], hellhounds were placed in the Wilderness Crater, making it the first [[members]] monster to be made free-to-play. It also broke the record of strongest, non-revenant, free to play monster with its pre-EoC combat level of 122. This title was relinquished to [[Deadly red spider]]s after the EoC launch.
* After the [[Update:Ring of Wealth, Shanties, Trolls and Dungeoneering|ring of wealth update]] on [[16 March]] [[2011]], the charm drop rates of hellhounds and [[rock lobster]]s had "gone walkabouts."{{CiteForum|author = Mod Sneakman|url = http://services.runescape.com/m=forum/forums.ws?15,16,525,62549891,goto,2|archivedate=18 March 2013|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/5765954|title = Hellhounds Nerf?|forum = Recent Updates|postdate = 16 March 2011|notes = }} This caused hellhounds to drop gold charms less frequently. Rather, they seemed to drop blue charms much more often. This was, however, fixed on 28 March as noted in the [[Update:Patch Notes (28 March 2011)|patch notes]] of that date.
